name: onX Offroad
description: onX Offroad brings 650,000+ miles of off-road trails directly into Claude. Search trails by location, technical difficulty, vehicle width, length, or seasonal conditions — and get interactive trail cards with ratings, photos, and real-time community condition reports. No onX account or app download required to get started. When you're ready to navigate, open any trail in the onX Offroad app for offline maps, turn-by-turn guidance, dispersed camping spots, and full trip planning tools.

_published_faq.name: How do I add onX Offroad to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add onX Offroad to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://www.onxmaps.com/claude/offroad/mcp.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the onX Offroad MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: onX Offroad provides these MCP tools: get_offroad_trail_list, get_offroad_trail, get_trail_details_by_id, and track_widget_event.

_published_faq.name: Does onX Offroad MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: onX Offroad does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
onX Offroad is developed by onX Maps. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
